query: UPDATE assistant_actions a SET state=CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id=$1 AND d.action_id=a.id) OR (a.operation_id='orders_refund' AND a.evidence->'refund'->>'refund_id' IS NOT NULL) OR (a.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND a.state IN ('queued','partial','failed'))) THEN a.state ELSE $7 END,http_status=$5,evidence=CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id=$1 AND d.action_id=a.id) OR (a.operation_id='orders_refund' AND a.evidence->'refund'->>'refund_id' IS NOT NULL) OR (a.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND a.state IN ('queued','partial','failed'))) THEN $6::jsonb || a.evidence ELSE a.evidence || $6::jsonb END,review_facts='{}'::jsonb,finished_at=CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_deliveries d WHERE d.workspace_id=$1 AND d.action_id=a.id) OR (a.operation_id='orders_refund' AND a.evidence->'refund'->>'refund_id' IS NOT NULL) OR (a.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND a.state IN ('queued','partial','failed'))) THEN a.finished_at WHEN $8 THEN now() ELSE NULL END WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND login_id=$3 AND id=$4 AND state IN ('dispatching','unknown','queued','partial','failed')
